user.title: Set up a KMTronic USB relay board
user.description: Select the serial port of the board. Prefer the /dev/serial/by-id/... path, it does not change across reboots.

data_description.port: Serial port of the board, for example /dev/serial/by-id/usb-KMtronic_Ltd._USB_8_Relays-if00.
data_description.relay_count: Number of relays on the board.

usb_confirm.title: KMTronic USB relay board
usb_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} on {port}?

error.cannot_connect: The board did not answer on this port. Check the cable and that no other program (such as the old MQTT add-on) is using it.

init.title: Relays
init.description: Choose how each relay is exposed in Home Assistant. Entities can then be renamed and given icons from their settings.

data_description.type: Switch or light: stays on/off. Button: impulse (gate, garage door). Disabled: no entity.
data_description.inverted: Enable when the load is wired on the normally closed contact: the entity is on when the relay is released.
data_description.pulse_duration: Buttons only: how long the relay stays active on each press.
